name: No Man's Sky

start.note: from the start to the title screen; flat first (VXRT_FLAT=1), Vulkan only on PC

summary.ja: 本物の Windows 版 Steam（ユーザー自身がサインイン、~/Verantyx_VR_Drive/vxrt_wsteam）を VXRuntime で動かし、そこから起動する（steam.exe -applaunch 275850、VR は -HmdEnable 1。scripts/launch_vxrt_nms_vr.sh）。Mac の画面では惑星の地形まで描画され、ユーザーが遊べた。VR では Vision Pro の VeRantyx アプリで映像と音を確認。ALVR は確認中。fps は未計測。
summary.en: Started by the real Windows Steam client on VXRuntime, signed in to by the user (~/Verantyx_VR_Drive/vxrt_wsteam): steam.exe -applaunch 275850, with -HmdEnable 1 for VR (scripts/launch_vxrt_nms_vr.sh). On the Mac's screen it draws the planet's terrain and the user played it. In VR, picture and sound checked in the Vision Pro's VeRantyx app. ALVR is being checked. Frame rates not measured yet.

known_issues.summary: 2026-10-25: the SteamStub error below is answered by the real Windows Steam client the user signed in to (VXRuntime/README.md "The Windows Steam client"), not by imitating Steam. Started directly with scripts/launch_vxrt_game.sh the game still stops there. In VR through ALVR, not checked yet; no harness run or fps measurement yet.

Flat runs on 2026-10-23 (scripts/launch_vxrt_game.sh with VXRT_FLAT=1, buildid 25732212): the SteamStub stub first needed msvcrt.dll!vsprintf (an int3 loop at NMS.exe+0x76e60ec when GetProcAddress failed) and RegisterTraceGuidsW; with both, steam_api64's SteamAPI_Init loads the Steam bridge (SteamClient017/014 created), then the stub opens the event and file mapping Local\SteamStart_SharedMemFile of a Windows Steam client, finds none and shows "Steam Error: Application load error 3:0000065558". Answering that Windows Steam client protocol ourselves would mean imitating Steam's DRM, which the rules forbid (AGENTS.md).

notes: Vulkan only on PC (the game carries the Khronos loader vulkan-1.dll; VXRuntime's built-in vulkan-1.dll is used instead). Also carries openvr_api.dll, DLSS/XeSS/Streamline, PlayFab/Party, NVIDIA Aftermath; no anti-cheat.
VXRT_DEBUGGER=0 is not needed for the stub's check (it failed the same way with and without).
